item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"C1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The program performs a file-based round trip: it serializes a `Predict` instance with a configured LM to a JSON file, reopens that saved JSON, injects an endpoint override into the serialized `lm` object, and writes the modified JSON back before loading.","span_ids":["S3"]},{"claim_id":"C2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The default load path uses `load(path)` without `allow_unsafe_lm_state`, so unsafe endpoint override keys such as `api_base` or `base_url` are sanitized out before the LM is reconstructed, and the loaded LM kwargs do not contain the injected override.","span_ids":["S1","S2","S4"]},{"claim_id":"C3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"A second load uses `load(path, allow_unsafe_lm_state=True)`, which preserves the serialized unsafe LM state, so the loaded LM kwargs retain the injected endpoint override URL.","span_ids":["S1","S2","S5"]},{"claim_id":"C4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":20,"statement":"The code makes the contrast explicit by directly checking or printing both loaded LM kwargs, showing that the safe load lacks the override key while the opt-in load contains it with the injected value.","span_ids":["S4","S5"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"S1","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":22,"end_line":40},{"span_id":"S2","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":92,"end_line":111},{"span_id":"S3","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":264,"end_line":274},{"span_id":"S4","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":276,"end_line":284},{"span_id":"S5","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":286,"end_line":306}]}
